svg.title: SELECT: mean percent weight change at week 104
svg.desc: Mean change from randomization to week 104: semaglutide −9.39% vs placebo −0.88% (estimated treatment difference −8.51 percentage points). Supportive secondary endpoint; not multiplicity-adjusted. Source: Lincoff et al., NEJM 2023, Table 3.
